name: Penalty Kicks
hook: Pick your corner. Hope the keeper guesses wrong.
how: Two teams take turns from the spot. The kicker aims and times a power bar while the keeper picks a dive, both in secret, then the kick shows who guessed right. Five each, then sudden death; everyone takes a turn kicking and in goal.
controls: Kicker: mouse or arrows to aim, hold and release Space or click for power · Keeper: ← ↓ → · touch: drag to aim, hold KICK; DIVE buttons
uses: Your aim or dive goes only to the host's browser, which shows both picks together when the kick happens.
The host's browser runs the turns, the timer and the score; if it leaves, the next player takes over and everyone re-sends their pick.
Bots fill the teams and each kicks and dives with its own favorite side.
Total goals scored, for every player.
ideas: Add a golden goal ball worth two in the last round
Let the keeper dive high or low too, not just left and right
Make it a snowy night match with the crowd waving flags
